technical.summary: Strong trend structure (ADX, long-term EMA alignment) conflicts with weak short-term momentum (RSI 9 at 32.85, price below key EMAs, negative MACD), three black crows pattern, and lack of volume confirmation—insufficient confluence for high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: EIX shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 7 days present elevated volatility risk with insufficient fundamental support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear sentiment (23/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news data limit conviction.

risk.summary: Crisis VIX (421.6), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and imminent earnings create a highly adverse risk environment for EIX.

debate.key_bull_argument: Strong ADX + EMA 50/200 bullish alignment with extreme fear sentiment (23/100) creates contrarian opportunity near support (57.87), but lacks confluence.
debate.key_bear_argument: Critical earnings risk (7 days), crisis VIX, price below EMA 9/21, RSI 32.85 (weak momentum), three black crows pattern, negative MACD, and zero volume confirmation make this a high-risk, low-probability entry.
